data.title: Marina Shores
data.about:
This 53-story tower offers direct access to the Marina Promenade and has memorable views of the Marina Promenade.

 There are one- to four-bedroom apartments available, as well as a glamorous five-bedroom penthouse with panoramic sea views. Marina Shores offers stylish homes for you and your loved ones to enjoy the best of life on the sun-soaked coast of Dubai Marina.
